source: COMMERCE & INDUSTRIES MINISTER-IN LUNGLEIAH AGRI-MARKETING & TRAINING INFRASTRUCTURE BUILDING HAWNG No.4122/2021-2022 Aizawl, the 26 th February 2022 : Commerce & Industries (C&I) Minister Dr R Lalthangliana chuan vawiin khan Electric Veng, Lungleiah NABARD sum cheng nuai 1082.93 senga ruahman Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building a hawng. Hawnna inkhawm Commerce & Industries Department Commissioner & Secretary, Pi Esther Lal Ruatkimi kaihhruaiah Dr R Lalthangliana chuan Lunglei khawpui chhunga hmasawnna ruhrel liantham, khawtlang tana chhenfakawm tak leh eizawnna kawnga tangkai taka hman theih tur Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building zawhfel a ni chu lawmawm tiin a buaipuitu Commerce & Industries thawktute, building sa tu te leh Electric Veng Lunglei khawtlang te chungah lawmthu a sawi a. C&I Department hnuaiah hmalakna hrang hrang kalpui mek zel anih thu sawiin Lunglei Supermarket sakna tur cheng nuai 1400 NEC atanga sanction hmuh anih thu sawiin Bangladesh ram nena kan insumdawn tawnna atana ruahman Integrated Check Post (ICP), Kawrpuichhuah, Tlabung ti hlawhtling turin Department chuan theihtawp a chhuah mek zel thu a sawi a ni. A Department chan dangte hnuaia hmalaknte pawh sawilangin Minister chuan MZU Southern Campus atan DPR cheng vaibelchhe 400 sawrkar laipuiah thehluh tawh niin chak taka bawhzui mek a ni a, MZU Southern Campus tana hman lailawk tur Engineering College building chei that hna pawh thawh mek a ni, a ti a. Civil Hospital Lungleia Trauma Centre sak pawh zawh fel thuai beisei anih thu sawiin Multipurpose Laboratory Building, NEC sum cheng nuai 300 a ruahman mek pawh nakum kum tir lama zawhfel beisei anih thu a sawi. Lunglei Municipal Council (LMC) chungchang pawh sawiin Minister chuan Municipal body chak tak enkawlna hnuaiah Lunglei khawpui chuan kawng hrang hrangin hmasawnna a nei dawn a ni, a ti. He huna khualzahawm Lunglei HPC Vice Chairman Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng chuan Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building hawn theiha peih fel a ni ta chu Pathian malsawmna ropui tak a ni tiin he hmasawnna ruhrel neih theihna tura sulsutute thawhrimna leh thahnemngaihna rah a ni, a ti a. He building ti hlawhtling tura bultan tu Pu Joseph Lalhimpuia chungah leh a hmun phal taka petu Electric Veng YMA te chungah lawmthu a sawi a ni. He building sak enkawltu AIE Constructions, Tuikhuahtlang, Aizawl atangin Technical Report ngaihtlak a ni a. Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure hi NABARD, RIDF XXIII hnuaia project niin total project cost hi Rs. 1082.93 lakhs ani a. Hna hi 05/10/2018 ah thawh tan a ni. A building plinth area hi 574.875 Square metres niin building hi floor nga (5) a sak a ni a. First floor hi Agriculture leh marketing lama training leh awareness centre atan ruahman niin mihring 300 vel leng tura hisap a ni. Ground floor ah hian guest room, conference/meeting room te awmin Basement I ah hian mi 78 lenna market area bakah market office ruamhan niin Basement II ah mi 85 lenna market area niin Basement III hi motor 25 lenna parking area-a ruahman a ni. reference: AGRI-MARKETING & TRAINING INFRASTRUCTURE BUILDING INAUGURATED AT LUNGLEI No.523/2021-2022 Aizawl, the 28th February 2022 : Commerce & Industries (C&I) Minister Dr R Lalthangliana on Saturday (26th February, 2022) inaugurated Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building at Electric Veng, Lunglei. The Rs. 1082.93 lakhs project is implemented under the NABARD, RIDF XXIII. Lunglei HPC Vice Chairman Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng was the guest of honour at the inauguration. At the inaugural function chaired by Commerce & Industries Department Commissioner & Secretary, Pi Esther Lal Ruatkimi, Commerce & Industries (C&I) Minister Dr R Lalthangliana commended C&I Department staff, Electric veng YMA, VCs for their contribution towards successful completion of the project. As per Technical Report presented by AIE Constructions, Tuikhuahtlang, Aizawl, the 5 floors Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building has a plinth area of 574.875 Square metres. The first floor is intended to be used as a training and awareness centre for agriculture marketing with an estimated capacity of 300 people, with guest rooms, conference/meeting rooms at the Ground floor. Basement I and Basement II contain the market areas and market offices, with a parking area at the basement.

reference: MIZORAM CHIEF SECRETARY LEADS GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES IN TAKING INTEGRITY PLEDGE 275/2023-2024 Vigilance Awareness Week, 2023 is to be observed in the whole of India from today, i.e. 30th October till 5th November, 2023. Starting off the Vigilance Week in Mizoram too, Chief Secretary Dr. Renu Sharma led the officials and staff of the Mizoram Secretariat, MINECO this morning in taking the 'Integrity Pledge' in the Secretariat Courtyard. Likewise, all Heads of Offices under the State Government also led the employees in their respective offices in taking the Integrity Pledge, in which each government servant avowed to follow probity and rule of law in all walks of life, to neither take nor offer bribe, to perform all tasks in an honest and transparent manner, to act in public interest, to lead by example exhibiting integrity in personal behavior and to report any incident of corruption to the appropriate agency. source: HEALTH MINISTER-IN MAMIT DISTRICT CHHUNGA HMAN TUR MOBILE MEDICAL VAN LEH HMANRAW DANGTE VAILIAM No.7589/2020-2021 Vawiin khan Dr. R. Lalthangliana, Minister, Health & Family Welfare Department, Higher & Technical Education, Commerce & Industries chuan Mobile Medical Van, Essential Drugs & Diagnostic Kits & Laptops and Speaker Mamit District Hospital, PHC/CHC leh Sub- Centre-a hman tur vailiam. Khuallian Dr. R Lalthangliana chuan Mamit District chhunga cheng te'n hriselna kawnga hma an sawn theihna tura hmanraw tangkai tak taka thuam an ni chu a lawmawm thusawiin District - 11 zinga Medical Doctor ngei District Bawrhsap, hriselna kawnga a ngaihna hria in nei chu in vannei takzet a. Aspirational District atangin Mizoram District 11- te zingah pakhatna ni thei tura tan la tura chahin in tum tlat chuan theihloh a awm lo a ni tiin kum zabi 21-a hmasawnna chu hmang tangkaiin dik taka kan hmachhawn chuan District hnufual ber thin kha a ropui ber kan ni thei a ni a ti. Dr. Thangtea chuan Pathian ringtu mizo nih hi a nuama, pi leh pute atanga lungrual tak leh inpumkhatna nena thawkho thin kan nihna chuan rah tha chhuah zelin, Covid - 19 avanga nunna chan kan nei erawh pawi hle rualin hri dona kawnga kan hmalakna-a hlawhtlinna kan hmuh mekte leh India hmarchhak State pariat (8) zingah Covid - 19 vanga thi tlemna ber State kan ni chu Pathian avang leh kan thawhhona avang a ni a ti. Minister chuan hmasawnna kan hmuh mekte chu chho zawnga thlira in delhbeh tir mai lovin hmasawnna tluantling nei turin kan tih ve theih tawk theuha tan la thar turin kalkhawmte a fuih a. Kawngpui tha nei turin hmalakna kalpui mek niin khawchhak lam atanga khawthlang lam hawiin kawngsial hna thawh tan mek a nih thu a sawi bawk. Er. H. Lalzirliana, Bialtu MLA pawhin Mamit District-in hriselna kawnga hma kan sawn theihna tur leh Aspirational District kan nihna atanga khaichhuah kan nihna tura CSR hnuai atanga hmanraw tangkai tak tak lei a ni chu lawmawm a tih thusawiin Kan District Bawrhsap-in hemi kawnga hma a lakna chu fakawm a tih thu a sawi a. Covid-19 hripuiin khawvel a tih buai mek karah Mizoram chu Sorkar hmalakna chak tak a vang te, Kohhran mite tawngtaina vang te leh khawtlang hruaitute hmalakna avangin India ram state zingah a titha ber pawl kan ni chu lawmawm a tih thu a sawi bawk. Bialtu MLA chuan Mamit District-in kawngpui tha kan neih chu Mizoram Sawrkarin a ngaihpawimawh berte zing a mi a nih avangin chak taka hmalakna kalpui a ni a, hun reilote-ah kawngpui tha kan nei thuai a beisei thu a sawi. Mamit District-in hriselna lama hma kan sawna, nu naupai te'n enkawlna tha zawk an dawn a, damdawi an mamawh angte an hmuh theihna tur bakah damlote enkawlna tha zawk leh rang zawk pek an nih theihna tura District chhung PHC/CHC leh Health Sub- Centre-te tana hmanraw lei hi Mamit District Bawrhsap hmalakna-in REC LTD, CSR Health Project hnuai atanga lei a ni. Vawiin-a sem tak Bolero Camper(4WD BS6) 11 lei nan hian Rs. 1,04,50,000/- hman niin Motor-te hi Health Care delivery a bik takin vaccination drive, Health camp conduct leh awareness pekna tur bakah, kawng that lohna hmun, motor naran in a thlen theih lohna khuate awlsam taka thlen theihnan 4 wheeled drive lei a ni a. Rs. 15,60,000/- senga lei damdawi chi hrang hrang 76 - Folic Acid, Oral rehydration salt, Ibuprofen, Ascorbic Acid (vitamin C), Albendazole, Paracetamol leh Diagnostic Kits 50 - Sahli's Haemoglobinometer, Pregnancy Test Kit, Malaria Test Kit, Typhoid Test Kit, BP Instrument Mercurial, Adult Weighing Machine, Hepatitis B-Test Kit leh a dangte Sub Centre/Health & Wellness Centre- te hman tur khuallian hian a hlan bawk. He Project hian a tum ber chu Health & welness Centre hi mi tam zawkin health care services an dawn theihna tur leh a tlawhtute mamawh damdawi leh diagnostic kit te a thlawna pek chhuah a ni a, health and welness centre hi mi tam zawkin hmang tangkaia, an tlawh tam (footfall) nana kalpui a ni. Vawiin vek hian Rs. 24,60,000/- senga lei Laptop leh Speaker 52, Mamit District chhung khua tlawh pawh harsa leh health care facility nei thalo khuate tan awlsam zawka health care provider te an biak pawh zung zung theihna turin Telemedicine atan Health Department hnenah hlan a ni bawk. He hun hi Dr. Lalrozama, IAS, Deputy Commissioner chuan kaihruaiin, Pu Beitlotha Nohro, SDC pawhin report pe-in Health Project hnuaiah Aspirational District kan nih avanga hriselna lama hma kan sawn theihna tura thuam kan nih dante a tarlang a. Dr. Vanlalfela, Chief Medical Officer, Mamit-in lawmthu sawina a nei bawk. Minister hi Er. H. Lalzirliana, 3-Mamit Bialtu MLA, Pu C. Lalrammawia, Chairman, ZOHANCO, Health Department Officials, Mamit khawpui chhunga Head of Offices bakah khawtlang hruaitute'n leh thutharthehdarhtute'n an tawiawm a ni. reference: MYC CHAIRMAN LAYS FOUNDATION STONE FOR MYC INCUBATION CENTRE AT SERKAWN, LUNGLEI No.573/2021-2022 Aizawl the 28th March, 2022 : MYC Chairman Dr Vanlaltanpuia, Lunglei North MLA laid the foundation stone for Mizoram Youth Commission Incubation Centre at Serkawn,Lunglei near Lena Stadium on Saturday (26th March, 2022). The land for the Incubation Centre was donated by Serkawn VC. Lunglei High Powered Committee Vice Chairman Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng, Pu H. Lalnunzuala, Under Secretary MYC, Pu Lalrotluanga, President YMA Sub-Headquarters Lunglei and representatives from Serkawn locality and various NGOs were also present at the occasion. On the occasion of this foundation stone laying ceremony, MYC Chairman Dr Vanlaltanpuia said this centre would cater to the needs of aspiring Mizo youths such as competitive coaching, Information Technology, skill development and entrepreneurship. He thanked the local leaders of Serkawn who donated the property to MYC, and promised them that the centre would be used for the betterment of society and the economy. Talking about the MYC Coaching Centres in Lunglei, Siaha, Kolasib Districts and the one in Champhai which will be opened shortly, the MYC Chairman said that he along with the MYC team would continue working in earnest for the advancement of Mizo youths to the best of their capabilities. He stated that construction of MYC Youth Centres are underway at Aizawl,Serchhip and Lunglei. In addition to competitive exams, MYC is planning to continue to provide cement mistiri training, food processing training, cake baking training, cabin crew, Army Pre-Recruitment training and promotion of music and sports to help the youths reach their goals at the national level. The MYC Chairman said that the MYC Super IAS 20 which was started in 2020 will be upgraded to Super IAS 40 which will comprise of 20 more aspirants. He further said that the road connecting Khawiva, Aizawl-Thenzawl-Lunglei road and roads in Lunglei town will be repaired and that the budget for the improvement works for MZU Southern Campus is raised to Rs.15 crore. Lunglei High Powered Committee Vice Chairman Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng shared that although the staff of MYC are few in number, their contributions to the future of Mizo youths are commendable. He stated his appreciation for the Incubation Centre and urged the people to make the most out of this centre. Pu Lalrotluanga, President YMA Sub-Headquarters Lunglei and Pu K. Zodinsanga, VCP Serkawn also gave a brief speech, Pu Lalmuanzuala, CC, MYC Lunglei ended the ceremony with vote of thanks speech. Attachment Loading attachment...

source: Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati in Sainik School Chhingchhip a tlawh 2122/2022-2023 Chhingchhip, the 30th September 2022: Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati chuan vawiin khan Sainik School Chhingchhip a tlawh a. He hunah hian School building leh hmunhma te a endik a, Sikul naupangte hmaah fuihna thu a sawi bawk a ni. Governor hian Sainik School a thlenin amah zahna chibai 8 Bn Assam Rifles ten School kawtah an lo buk a. Wcdr Shahul Hameed, Principal leh Maj S.Kalyan, Administrative Officer ten zirtirtute leh School staff te an hmelhriattir chhunzawm a. Hemi zawh hian Principal Office ah Sainik School dinhmunte inhrilhhriatna hun neih leh a ni a. Assembly Hall-ah Official programme leh Cultural Programme neih chhunzawm nghal a ni. Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati chuan Principal leh a thawhpui ten Sainik School tha tak ni tur leh hmun danga Sainik School te dinhmun pha tura theihtawp an chhuah chu fakawm a tih thu a sawi hmasa a. Mizoram sawrkarin hetiang ang School tha bik Mizorama zirlaite tan a buatsaih thei chu lawmawm a tih thu a sawi bawk a ni. Sainik School Chhingchhip hi India ram hmundang te aia a danglam bik na chu helai hmunah hian Sainik School dangte entawn turin a vawikhatna atana leh a hmahruaitu ni turin hmeichhe naupangte luh tir an ni a. Hei hi a chhuanawm tak zet a ni a ti. Sainik School te hi khawi hmunah pawh School thabik an ni a, Sipai, Navy leh Airforce Officer ni turin a bik takin heng schoolah te hian zirlai te zirtirna pek a ni a ti. Sainik School a zirlaite hi Armed Forces ah an thawkvek kher lo a nih pawhin khawtlang leh ram tana khua leh tui entawn tlak ni tura chher an nih thu a sawi bawk. India chakna chu danglamna tam tak kara inpumkhatna leh inunauna tha a ni tih zirlaite chu a hrilh nawn leh a. He mawhphurhna huangah hian Sainik School zirlaite chu hmahruaitu ni turin a chah a ni. Principal Report atanga a lan dan chuan Sainik School Chhingchhip hi kum 6 hmel a hmu mek a. Tunah hian batch hmasa ber(Class VI) te chu Class XI an ni mek a ni. Sainik School a lut tur hian All India Entrance Test paltlang a ngai a. Sikul naupang pakhat tana kum khat chhunga senso chu Rs 1.85 lakh velah chhut a ni. School naupangte hian zing dar 5 vel atangin zan dar 9:30 vel thleng nitin, lehkha zirna hun, infiamna leh thildang tangkai zir nan hun an hmang thin a. An harsatna pahnih Tui Bill sang tak leh Electric chhit man sang lutuk chungchangte pawh sawi a ni. Kawlphetha a harsatna sutkian a nih theih nan campus chhunga Solar Power Generation Plant bun turin Governor chuan Sainik School Chhingchhip hotute chu thurawn a pe a. reference: Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati visits Sainik School Chhingchhip 191/2022-2023 Chhingchhip, the 30th September 2022: Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati who is on an official tour of Serchhip District visited Sainik School, Chhingchhip, a few miles away from Serchhip town today. Upon his arrival, Governor was accorded the Guard of Honour by 8 Bn of Assam Rifles. He was then introduced to the staff by Wcdr Shahul Hameed, Principal, and Maj S.Kalyan, Administrative Officer. A briefing about the School to Governor was given by the Principal in his office room. After this, an official function with a cultural program was organized inside the Assembly Hall in honour of the esteemed visitor. Here, the Governor addressed the students. Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati congratulated faculties for their best effort to keep up with other establishwd Sainik Schools in the country. He thanked the state government for bring up a highly valuable asset of national importance in education like Sainik school here in Mizoram. He expressed his pride of having the first Sainik School in the country where girl students are admitted. He stressed the importance of Sainik Schools for preparing the young students to become cadet officers in Army, Airforces and Navy. Beside this, he said the school also prepared the students to become role model students and role model citizen. He reminded the students of the school about their important duties for the national integration of the county. Full speech of the Honble Governor : https://dipr.mizoram.gov.in/post/speech-of-dr-hari-babu-kambhampati-honble-governor-of-mizoram-on-the-occasion-of-visit-to-sainik-school-chhingchhip-on-30th-september-2022 The programme began with welcome address by Maj S.Kalyan, Admn and concluded with vote of thanks proposed by WCdr Shahul Hameed, Principal, Sainik School, Chhingchhip. After the official programme, Governor inspected the facilities inside the campus of Sainik School Chhingchhip. As per the briefing by the Principal, here are the few highlights of the school. The school is now 6 years old and running with the pilot cadets in Class XI. The annual intake of students are 60 boys and 10 girls in the class VI while in the class IX only boys are admitted with the availability of 10 seats for students annually. The annual fee per a student is estimated at Rs 1.85 lakh per year. The schools have daily routine for winter and summer and winter with the physical and classroom activities through out the day. It usually starts from very early morning till 9:00 to 9:30 PM at night. Apart from the facilities for cocurricular activities, the School is also currently having the facilities like Football Ground, Badminton Court, Basketball Court, Gynasium, Music room,etc.,. The swimming pool, parade ground and other big sports facilities are being planned to be added very soon. The Principal highlighted the status of Grant in Aid from the state, issues with water and power bills, LMV ambulance to be received from the Mizoram Rural Bank through CSR, INSAS rifles to be received from Home Department, Government of Mizoram, Infrastructural Fund received to the tune of Rs 99,96,000 the Ministry of Defence with the proposed implementations. To solve the issue with high power bills, the Governor advised implementation of Solar Power Generation plant inside the campus. While, the issue with high water bills is being taken up the office Deputy Commissioner and is expected to be solved very soon. Governor in his visit to Sainik School, Chhingchhip was escorted and given a company by Pu Lalmuansanga Ralte, Addl DC and Pu Stephen Lalrinawma, SP, Serchhip District. source: Presbyterian Communications Board/Department hna pui ber chu thu ziak rawngbâwlnain hma a sâwn zêl theih nân, Synod leh a hnuaia pêng hrang hrangten thil chhut tûr an neih apiang fel taka chhut te, chûng zînga zawrh chi chu mipuiin an lei theih tûra a tlâwm thei anga zawrh a ni. Synod hnuaia Department hrang hrangten lehkhabu leh thil dang chhut ngai an neihte chu Synod Press-a chhut zêl tûra tih a ni a (SEC 233:39). reference: The main objectives of the Presbyterian Communication Board/Department is to spread the Gospel through publication and printing words and it is responsible for the publication of any works required by Synod and all the departments under it. It also provides cheaper and accessible books for the masses as well. Synod and its departments are to publish their books and any other publication under Synod Press. (SEC 233:39). Similarly, all the departments are to buy their stationary needs from the Synod Bookroom as well. {Synod Sum VawnDân Bung 10:10 (1)}.
hypothesis: The primary function of the Presbyterian Communications Board/Department is to ensure that all materials produced by the Synod and its various divisions are accurately reproduced and distributed in such a way that they are available for purchase by the public. Pathianin kan chhûngah a thlarau a dah a, tichuan a thlarau chu kan chhûngah chenchilhtu Thlarau a ni ang a, Pathian hriatna leh Pathian lama Krista-in kan tâna a hlenchhuah zawng zawng tawnhriatna kan nei thei dawn a ni (Rom 8:9-11). reference:
A. As the Indwelling Spirit
God puts His Spirit in us so that His Spirit may be the indwellingSpiritwithinus,thatwemayknowGodandexpe- rience all that God in Christ has accomplished for us (Rom. 8:9-11). This is the special blessing given by God in the New Testament era; it did not exist in the Old Testament. In the OldTestament,GodonlycausedHisSpirittocomefromwith- out to work upon man; He did not cause His Spirit to dwell withinman. Only after the Lord’s death and resurrection did God give His Spirit to us and cause His Spirit to dwell in us as the indwelling Spirit (John 14:16-17). Thus, He is able to reveal both God and Christ to us from within,that we in Christ may receive and enjoy the fullness of God (Col. 2:9-10).
hypothesis: (Romans 8:9-11) This is a special blessing given by God during the New Covenant; it is not contained in the Old Covenant at all. In the New Covenant, God created his Spirit to work on the outer man, and did not raise up his Spirit to dwell in the inner man. It was only after the Lord's death that God created us with his Spirit so that we would live as the first man (John 14:16-17).

reference: In the Scriptures, only 1 John 2:27 speaks of the “teach- ing of the anointing.” We all know that anointing is a verbal noun which refers to the activity of the ointment, the mov- ing and the working of the ointment.According to the type of the Old Testament and the fulfillment of the New Testa- ment, ointment or oil in the Scripture refers to the Holy Spirit(Isa.61:1;Luke4:18).Sinceointmentoroilreferstothe Holy Spirit, the “anointing” must refer to the working of the Holy Spirit. The working of the Holy Spirit in us is like the anointing of the ointment; therefore, the Scripture calls this working of the Holy Spirit the “anointing.”
hypothesis: In the Bible, 1 John 2:27 refers to the doctrine of the anointing. The anointing is the act of speaking in tongues, the act of anointing, the conduct, and the work of anointing. (Isaiah 61:1; Luke 4:18) The anointing or anointing of the Holy Spirit must have been the work of the Holy Spirit, since the Holy Spirit was poured out. The work of the Holy Spirit in us is the same as the work of the anointing; hence the Scriptures refer to the work of the Holy Spirit as anointing.

source: CHIEF MINISTER IN RIPANS AH GRADUATION LEH LAMP LIGHTING CEREMONY A HMANPUI Vawiin khan Chief Minister Pu Zoramthanga chuan Regional Institute of Paramedical and Nursing Sciences(RIPANS) ah kumina Nursing leh Paramedical Course hrang hranga zirlai pass thar te graduation lawmna leh Bachelor of Nursing zirlai thar 35-te lawmluhna Lamp Lighting Ceremony chu khuallian niin a hmanpui a. Zirlai titha zual te hnenah Proficiency Award a hlan bawk. Chief Minister chuan graduate tharte chu a lawmpui thu a sawi a. Mahni mihring puite tan an thiamna hmang a, enkawl dam hna thawh chu hna ropui tak a nih thu sawiin, zirlai pass tharte chu an kal zelna turah pawh taima leh rinawm taka an thawh zui a, hlawhtlinna an chan chhoh zel turin a duhsakna a hlan. Chief Minister chuan Mizoramah mihring hriselna tihhmasawn a inenkawlna tha zawk neih chu sawrkarin a ngaihpawimawh thu a sawi a. Chumi atan chuan sawrkar chauhin thil a tih theihloh thu leh, hriselna kawnga ramin hma a sawn tak tak dawn chuan mipui tawiawmna a mamawh thu a sawi. Chief Minister chuan RIPANS pawh changtlung zawka siam tura hmalakna awm mek chu lawmawm a tih thu sawiin, thawktu indaihlohna avanga harsatna an tawh chungchangah theih tawp chhuahpui a tum thu a sawi a ni. Chief Minister chuan graduate thar te zingah an department theuh a titha zualte hnenah RIPANS Proficiency Award a hlan bawk. Vawiin hunah hian RIPANS Director Dr. Chawngthanliana leh Lamp Lighter Civil Hospital Nursing Superintendent Pi Lalrinthangi ten thu an sawi bawk. BSc Nursing First year hi an vawiin mi 35 an ni a. RIPANS Director Dr. Chawngthanliana chuan Graduate leh Post Graduate tharte hnenah Certificate of Appreciation a hlan a ni. Kumin hian a vaiin mi 180 zirchhuak an awm a. Chungte chu: i) B.Sc. Nursing - 36 ii) B.Sc. MLT (Medical Laboratory Technology) - 40 iii) B. Pharm - 23 iv) B. Optometry - 34 v) B.Sc. RIT (Radio Imaging Technology) - 31 vi) M. Pharm - 16 RIPANS hi kum 1996 khan North Eastern Council (NEC) in India hmarchhak mite tan Paramedical leh Health Sciences bik zirna atana din in, kum 2007 April thla atangin sawrkar laipuia Ministry of Health and Family Welfare hnuaiah dah a ni ta a. Tun dinhmunah Degree Course hrang hrang panga - B.Sc Nursing, B.Sc Medical laboratory Technology, B. Pharm, B. Optometry leh B.Sc Radio Imaging Technology bakah October 2014 atang khan Post Graduate Course M. Pharm te awmin, India hmarchhak state hrang hrang atangin zirlaite tan seat hauhsa (quota) neiih zirlai 655 an awm mek a ni. Kum 1996 atanga kumin 2019 thleng hian RIPANS atanga zirchhuak mi 2820 an awm tawh a ni. Ministry of Health & Family Welfare hnuaia Executive Council meeting kumin kumtir a neihin RIPANS tihchangtlun na turin Rs. 480.12 crores pek a remti a. He hmalakna hnuaiah hian khum 100 awm theihna hospital, Academic building, Indoor Sports Complex cum Auditorium, P.G. Hostel, Guest House, Medical Superintendent Quarter, Doctor Quarter, Nurses/ Staff quarter sakna tur te, thawktu post 154 siam belhna tur leh Course thar pasarih hawnna tur te a tel a ni. reference: CHIEF MINISTER ATTENDED GRADUATION AND LAMP LIGHTING CEREMONY AT RIPANS Chief Minister Pu Zoramthanga attended the Lamp Lighting & Graduation Ceremony at Regional Institute of Paramedical and Nursing Sciences(RIPANS), Aizawl as chief guest yesterday. Speaking on the occassion, the Chief Minister offered his congratulations to the graduates, wishing them success in their future careers. He also encouraged the new B.Sc Nursing students to be diligent in their studies to become exceptional healthcare professionals, which is one of the most noble profession. Speaking of how the government takes various measures to ensure examplary healthcare system, the Chief Minister said that public support is needed for success. In yesterday's function the Chief Minister gave away Proficiency Award to toppers of all departments in the institute. This year saw 180 graduates from RIPANS with 36 B.Sc. Nursing, 40 B.Sc. MLT (Medical Laboratory Technology), 23 B. Pharm, 34 B. Optometry, 31 B.Sc. RIT (Radio Imaging Technology) and 16 M. Pharm. Dr. Chawngthanliana, Director, RIPANS handed out Certificate of Appreciation to the new Graduates and Post Graduates. 35 students of B.Sc Nuring were newly inducted through the Lamp Lighting Ceremony with Pi Lalrinthangi, Nursing Superintendent, Civil Hospital Aizawl as lamp lighter. RIPANS was set up by the Ministry of Home Affairs in 1995-96 under North Eastern Council (NEC). Then it was transferred to the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare on April, 2007. As of 2019, 2820 students have graduated from RIPANS since it's inception in 1996. Presently, there are 655 students enrolled in the six departments the institution offers. With the recommendation of the Meeting of Executive Council of the Institute under the Ministry earlier this year which approved Rs. 480.12 cr. for Upgradation and Development of RIPANS, plans to open seven more departments. Apart from this, creation of 154 posts including that of medical doctors, nurses and other paramedics, and infrastructural developments including hospitals, academic building, sports complex, hostel and quarters are underway. source: GOVERNOR PU HARI BABU KAMBHAMPATI IN CHAMPHAI WINERY TLAWH, PMUY LEH PMAY-HFA URBAN HAMTHATNA DAWNGTUTE TLAWHIN A KAWM 3449/2022-2023 Champhai, the 1st February, 2023: Ni hnih cham tura Champhai tlawha thang mek Mizoram Governor Pu Hari Babu Kambhampati chuan vawiin chawhnu khan Champhai Winery, Tlangsam tlawhin an hmalaknate a enfiah a; Champhal Grape Growers Society leh Hnahlan Grape Growers and Processing Co-operative Society Limited hotute a kawm bawk. Hemi hnu hian Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) leh Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Housing for All (Urban) hnuaia hamthatna dawngtute tlawhin a kawm a ni. Governor hi Environment, Forest & Climate Change Minister Pu T.J. Lalnuntluanga, Champhai South bialtu MLA ni bawk bakah DC Champhai Pu James Lalrinchhana, SP Pu Lalrinpuia Varte leh Official dangten an tawiawm a ni. Governor Pu Hari Babu Kambhampati chuan Champhai Winery tlawh theia a awm chu lawmawm a tih thu sawiin, an hmalaknate engemawchen a lo hriat tawh thu a sawi a. Champhai District-a Winery pahnih lai a awm leh loneitute intelkhawmin an kalpui chu ropui a tih thu a sawi a. Grape chingtuten harsatna an tawh chu pawi a tih thu sawiin, Sawrkarin dan thar siama hma a la chu lawmawm a ti a. Wine siam chu food processing hnuaia a awm anih thu sawiin, agriculture product-te cheibawla siam danglam value addition chu hmalakna pawimawh tak a ni, a ti a. Tun aia nasaa huang zauh leh changtlung zawka kal tura Ministry of Food Processing Industries kaltlanga hmalakna an nei chu lawmawm a tih thu a sawi bawk. Governor chuan Grape chauh nilo thei dang sawr leh um theihte pawh ngaihvena huang zauh a tul thu a sawi a. An hmalak lehzelna turah duhsakna a hlan a, Mizoram mai nilo India rama loneitute tana entawntlak leh tihhmuhtu nih tum turin a chah a ni. Environment, Forest & Climate Change Minister Pu T.J. Lalnuntluanga chuan Champhai District chhunga loneitute hmalakna pawimawh tak grape sawngbawlna hmunhma Governor-in a hun hlu tak senga a tlawh chu lawmawm a ti a. Hun harsa tak paltlanga dan anga grape zawrhna tur dan thar Sawrkarin a siam thu sawiin, grape chingtuten hmabak eng tak an neih thu sawiin duhsakna a hlan a. Tun aia nasa zawka hma la a, ram ngaw humhalh nan kum tina lovah thin bansana lo nghet nei thei tura ngaihtuahna seng turin a chah a. Tun atanga reiloteah Sapthei sawngbawlna turte pawh buaipui tum anih thu sawiin, harsatna an neihte a hnena thlen hrehlo turin a chah a ni. Inkawmhona hun Packing Hall, Champhai Winery, Tlangsama hman hi Pu HS.Vanlalfakzuala, Chairman, Champhai Grape Growers Society (CGGS) chuan a kaihruai a. Pu Hrilchunglura, General Manager hnen atangin report ngaihthlak a ni a. Hnahlan Grape Growers and Processing Co-operative Society Limited hotute atangin thusawi ngaihthlak a ni bawk. Mizoram hi North East India-a grape thar awm chhun leh India rama grape thar tam 5-na niin, Champhai leh Hnahlan-ah Winery a awm a. CGGS enkawl Champhai Winery hian kum 14 hmel a hmu tawh a, an Grape sawngbawl hi Bangalore Blue variety niin, vawiin thlengin Grape quintal ,15,218 an lei tling tawh a, hemi atan hian Rs 5,78,41,160/- (cheng vaibelchhe nga maktaduai sarih nuai riat singli sangkhat za leh sawmruk) an seng tawh a ni. Kum 2010 atang khan Grape quintal 918 leiin bul an tan a, kum kalta khan quintal 1144.98 an lei tling a, an Grape lakte hi herin a umna zemah an um mek a ni. Kum 2007 khan Champhai Grape Growers Association (CGGA) tih thin chu Winery din anih dawn avangin Champhai Grape Growers Society (CGGS) ti a thlak niin, Firms & Society-ah an inziahlut a ni. MIP sum cheng nuai 83 (loan) hmanga bultan niin, he loan hi November ni 9, 2020 khan Sawrkar chuan rulh let ngai lo turin grant-ah a leh sak a ni. Champhai Grape Growers Society-ah hian Governing Board Member 15 awmin kum 2 danah inthlan thin a ni a. Tun dinhmunah hian Champhai Grape Growers Society-ah hian Grape chingtu member 134 awm mekin, Staff leh Worker mi 30, Executive Member 9 leh Office Bearer 6 an awm mek bawk a. Champhai Grape Growers Society hnuaiah hian Branch 9 awm mekin mumal taka inenkawlna kalpui thin a ni. CGGS hian Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MOFPI) kaltlangin project an kalpui mek a. DC Office kaltlangin Pradhan Mantri Jan Vikas Karyakram (PMJVK) hnuaiah Commerce & Industries Department hnuaiah project dil mek a ni bawk a. Dan thar hnuaiah Winery License an nei fel tawh a, State pawn thlenga hralhchhuak thei turin hmachhawp an nei a ni. Champhai Winery a tlawh zawh hian Governor chuan BPL family-te tana a thlawna eirawngbawlna gas connection pekna scheme, Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) kaltlanga hamthatna dawngtu leh khawpuia cheng insak tanpuina scheme, Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Housing for All (Urban) dawngtu Tlangsam ami te a tlawh a; scheme awmzia leh tangkainate a sawifiah a, an hmuh dan leh chhawr tangkai dante a zawt nghal bawk. reference: Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati visits Champhai Tlangsam Winery 326/2022-2023 Aizawl, the 1st February 2023 : Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati, who is on a two-day tour of Champhai District visited the Tlangsam Winery on the outskirt of Champhai Town this evening. At the site, Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati was given an escorted tour to various units by the managing officers of the winery. Thereafter, a short program was held at B Remmawia Packing hall, Champhai Winery. Governor Hari Babu expressed his delight in visiting the factory started, owned, and managed by a society of farmers. He was particularly appreciative of having witness the production centre where the determined farmers themselves added value to their products. He congratulated the Champhai Grape Growers Society and the Hnahlan Grape Growers and Processing Co-operative Society Ltd. Governor welcomed the ambitious proposal to upgrade these wineries at Champhai and Hnahlan to accomodate the growing production of the Grapes in these areas. He extended his support for this proposal and if necessary, he agreed to discuss the matter with the authorities in the Ministry of Food Processing Industries(MoFPI). On behalf of Champhai Winery, Pu Hrilchunglura, General Manager, Champhai Grape Growers Society(GGGS) gave a report. The Winery was started in 2007. After 14 years of existence with the production actually started in 2010 the Winery has now grown. At present the society has 134 members. The fruit is of Bangalore Blue variety. During last year the Winery bought 1144.98 qts of grapes. As the grape production increases, CGGS submitted two projects - one project to MoFPI and another project to state department under Pradhan Mantri Jan Vikas Karyakram (PMJVK). source: PU LAWMAWMA TOCHHAWNG VICE CHAIRMAN HPC IN RENOVATED LUNGLEI POLICE STATION BUILDING A HAWNG 1328/2023-2025 Lunglei;the 1st August,2023 : Vawiin chawhma dar 11:30Am khan Lunglei Police Station Building(Ground Floor) thawmthat chu khuallian Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng, Vice Chairman, HPC Lunglei in a hawng. Building thawmthatna sum hi Lunglei High Powered Committee Fund atanga dawn a ni a. Ground floor leh 1st Floor renovate nan hian Rs.15 lakh ve ve HPC Fund atangin sanction a ni a. Kum 2022-2023 a fund in vawiina hawn tak Ground floor hi siam a ni a. 1st Floor renovate na tur pawh 2023-2024 atan Rs.15 lakh sanction tawh niin, Police Department ten thawmthat hna an thawh theih ve leh hna hi thawh tan theih reng a ni. Lunglei police station building hi kum 1991 a sak tawh kha a ni a, Lunglei khawpui hmun lun lai taka awm a ni a, a building hi a hlui tawh hle a ni. Vawiin renovated Police Station Building hawnna inkhawmah thu sawiin, Pu Lawmawma chuan Lunglei Police station hi India ram pumah Best Police station nihna chelh mektu a ni a,tehna hrang hrang hmanga teh a ni hnuah India ram pumpuia tha ber nihna hauh thei police station in, Mizoram a Police station building tha ber ni tura renovate a han ni hi anihna (best) nen pawh a inhmeh hle a ni. Police te ka lawmpui rualin kei pawhin ka thil hriat ve reng tur tling a ni, a ti. Pu Lawmawma chuan Lunglei Police station staff ten neitu rilru pu a an building thawmthat hna an thawk chu ropui a ti thu sawiin, fak phu te nena hnatawh ho chu a nuam hle a ni, a ti bawk. Khuallian chuan Lunglei Police te chu an hna huamchhung traffic management bikah India ram puma tha ber nihna chelhtu nih tum leh turin a chah a. reference: PU LAWMAWMA TOCHHAWNG VICE CHAIRMAN HPC INAUGURATES RENOVATED LUNGLEI POLICE STATION BUILDING 151/2023-2024 Lunglei;the 1st August,2023 : Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng, Vice Chairman, HPC Lunglei inaugurated a newly renovated Lunglei Police Station Building(Ground Floor) here in Lunglei town, today. Lunglei PS building was constructed wayback in 1991 and the building became dilapidated and worn out.Lunglei PS building is a two storey building. Lunglei High Powered Committee Funded this renovation works, at the tune of Rs.15 lakh for each storey. Rs.15 lakh was released for the year 202-2023 which was being used for renovation of Ground Floor, which was inaugurated today. Fund for 1st Floor renovation is also released for the year 2023-2024 and renovation works will be carried out by Police dept, at their earliest. In his augural speech Pu Lawmawma highlighted that Lunglei PS managed to bag the Best Police Station of India Award during 2022-2023.It is quite befitting that the building is also renovated to become the best PS building in Mizoram. He applauded the renovation works executed by PS staff with their all out efforts and with a spirit of love and ownership to get the best result. He exhorted them, since they could manage to bag the Best PS Award too, to try for the Best in traffic management in the whole India. He implored PS staff to be friendly and polite all the time, so that the public will not have any hesitation and fear in approaching the Police station in their time of troubles and distresses. Pu H.Ramthlengliana,IPS,DIG(SR) and Pi Ramdinliani IAS, DC delivered speeches in this function as well. Pu H.Ramthlengliana,IPS,DIG(SR) informed the gathering public how HPC had helped police dept. time and again since many past years and said that renovation works was just one amongst many. He entreated and reminded the police dept. to pay back many blessings they had received from various quarters by rendering their best services to the society. Pi Ramdinliani IAS, DC Lunglei heartily congratulated PS staff for their newly renovated building and applauded them for their dedication and hard work put forth in their renovation works and added that it was worth emulating for other depts. She stressed for the need of proper nutritional diet, negative effect of having excess sugar and salt in human body, feeding children with proper nutrition and the role of Women SHGs in women empowerment. reference: Mizoram Governor felicitates the first-rank holders of MBSE Class 10 & 12 Examination 71/2024-2025 Aizawl, the 27th May, 2024: Governor Dr. Hari Babu Kambhampati felicitated the first-rank holders of the High School Leaving Certificate and Higher Secondary School Leaving Certificate Examination 2024 at the Raj Bhavan, today. The topper from HSLC and three toppers from arts, commerce and science stream of HSSLC received Cash Incentives and Citations from the Governor. David Lalhminghlua s/o Paul Zakhuma, St. Paul's Higher Secondary School, Aizawl is the topper in Commerce stream and Linden Lalremruatpuia s/o C. reference: DISTRICT TASK FORCE COMMITTEE HELD EMERGENCY MEETING ON COVID-19 AT SIAHA District Task Force,Siaha mulled over how to take preventive measures against Covid-19 pandemic in the emergency meeting held, here at Siaha. District Magistrate had already issued prohibitory order on last Friday(7/3/2020), the order prohibited Cross- border movement between Myanmar and India through passages/roads that linked Myanmar and 10 villages within Siaha district namely: : Lopu, Chapi, Khaikhy, Zyhno,Lodaw, Lomasu, Iana, Siasi, Laki and Khopai village. The Same order highlighted that Check points will be set up at 3 villages namely: Kaochao, Tlapi and Tipi Ferry which located at Inter District Border. In pursuant to the said prohibitory Order, Siaha BDO and Tipa BDO have left for those 10 villages to call for GramSabha meeting and to sensitize about Covid-19 and Prohibitory Order. Today's meeting resolved that villagers of those 10 villages be requested to form a joint committee comprising of Church, NGOs and Village council to vigil over border passage/road that linked their respective village and Myanmar.The meeting also resolved that MADC Forest Guard and India Army stationed at villages located India-Myanmar Border be requested to help proposed village's Joint committee in their vigilant works on Border road/passage. Today's meeting also decided that on the 13th&14th March,2020 a Team comprising Medical officials, Leaders of NGOs, Joint VC members, Police personnel and DC office staff will visited those 13 villages and witness preventive measures taken by each village and carry out sensitization campaign as well. CMO & DMS informed the meeting that there was only one Thermal Infra Red Sensor and 15 Personal Protection Equipments (PPE) presently at Siaha; and 2 TIRS will arrive shortly. TIRS and Self Reporting Format will be placed at check points; and by using TIRS leh Self reporting format; suspected Covid-19 infected travellers will be identified and quarantine for 20 days. Hei hi rahbi hmasa ber chu a ni. Hei hi kan ti zo tawh anih chuan, hetah hian enfiahna ka dah thei; thil hmasa ber chu zawh a ni tawh. A rahbi pahnihna chu enge ni? Aigupta kan kalsan ang a, Krista chu kan nitin manna, kan nitin nun- chawmna angin kan chên tur a ni. Tui in lo in chaw kan ei thei lo a; chumi rual chuan Krista chu tuinung luang chhuak nena awm lungpui ang in kan chên tur a ni. Manna kan chên a, tuinung leh lungpui chu kan chên bawk a. Chutiang tawnhriatna chu nitin i nei em? Mi tam tak chuan in nei tih huaisen takin in sawi thei a. Nitin in Krista chu in chaw ang leh in intur angin in chên a. Chuti anih loh chuan, in nung thei lo a, in kal zel thei lo a, in nun chu Kristian angin in vawngṭha thei lo. Nitin in kan nitin chaw leh kan tuinung ang in Krista chu kan chên ngei ngei tur a ni, ei tur thil engemaw leh in tur thil engemaw kan nei ngei tur a ni. Zing ah kan inhmuh apiang in chibai kan inbûkna atan “Zing ṭha!” inti ngawt lovin “I ei tawh em?” tiin i inzawt zawk ang u. Chutiang chibai inbûkna chu ka thlang zawk daih mai. Tukin zing ah hian i ei tawh em, unaupa? Tukin zingah hian engemaw i in tawh em, unaunu. Thenkhat chuan vawiin ah chaw ṭha tak vawi thum in ei tawh tiin min chhang thei a. Lalpa chu fakin awm rawh se! Nitin Krista in kan inhrai tlai ṭhin tih hi mite hnenah kan hrilh ngei tur a ni. Krista chu kan ei a, Krista chu kan in a. reference: What then is the way to possess the good land? It is not so simple. Let us enumerate and review the steps. First of all, we must enjoy Christ as the redeeming lamb. We must receive Christ as our Savior. We must pass the judgment of God. This is the first step. If we have done this, we can put a check here; the first item has been passed. What is the second step? We must leave Egypt and enjoy Christ as our daily manna, as our daily life-supply. Of course, we cannot take food without drinking water; so at the same time we must enjoy Christ as the rock with the living water flowing forth. We enjoy the manna and we enjoy the rock with the living water. Do you have such an experience day by day? Many of you can boldly say that you do. Every day you enjoy Christ as your food and as your drink. Otherwise, you could not live, you could not go on, you could not maintain your life as a Christian. Day by day, we must enjoy Christ as our daily food and our living water; we must have something to eat and something to drink. Whenever we meet in the morning, instead of greeting one another with “Good morning!” let us ask “Have you eaten?” I do prefer such a greeting. Have you eaten this morning, brother? Have you drunk something this morning, sister? Some of you can answer that you have had three good meals today. Praise the Lord! We must tell people that day by day we are feeding on Christ. We are eating Christ and we are drinking Christ. If we have this experience, we can check this also.

reference: CHAMPHAI DISTRICT CONSULTATIVE COMMITTEE (DCC) & DISTRICT LEVEL REVIEW COMMITTEE (DLRC) No.517/2020-2021 Champhai District Consultative Committee (DCC) & District Level Review Committee (DLRC) under the Chairmanship of Pi Maria C.T. Zuali, Deputy Commissioner Champhai held meeting today at DCâ€™s Conference Hall, the Chairman launched the Potential Credit Linked Plan (PLP) 2021-2022 for Champhai District. Chairman urged the Bankers to conduct massive and wider public awareness campaign on facilities provided through Banks. Also the Deputy Commissioner reiterated the urgency of making application forms more simplified instead of intricated forms to facilitate ease of doing business. Pu L.Lawmvela, Lead District Manager (LDM), SBI Lead Bank Office delivered welcome speech followed by discussion on the performances of Bankers and Stakeholders for the quarter ended September, 2020. According to the reporting period, Credit-Deposit (CD) ratio was 44.71 %, against the norm of 60%. Achievement under Priority Sector was 38.42 % while it was 73.43% under Non Priority Sector. Under Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) there were 34 beneficiaries (Sishu-20, Kishore-98, Tarun-12, Stand Up India-4) getting loan amounting rupess 200.49 lakhs. Target achievement under Government Sponsored Schemes were also discussed at length. Forty two Bakijai Cases amounting rupees 21.61 lakhs have been reported, and no recovery is reported during the quarter. Non Performing Asset (NPA) under Priority Sector was rupees 1217.20 lakhs (7.07%) while the same in Non Priority Sector was rupees 86.40 lakhs (2.25%). Annual Credit Plan Target for Financial Year 2021-2022 and PMEGP Annual Credit Plan Target were also discussed and approved at the meeting. Also Social Security Schemes, Currency remittance, Bank security, Calendar for DCC meeting and timely submission of DCC data were also discussed among other issues. As of now, there are 15 different Banks branches operating in the district; 4 Public Sector Banks, 4 Private Sector Banks, 6 Regional Rural Banks and 1 State Cooperative Bank. There are a total of 9 ATMs, 8 Business Correspondents, 1 CSP, 26 IPPB Banking Touch Points and 2 Financial Literacy Centres (Lead Bank Office, SBI Sponsored and Champhai Financial Literacy Centre, MCAB Ltd.) in the district. reference: Then what will be the ultimate issue? Simply this—on the one hand, there will be the New Jerusalem, and on the other, the lake of fire. The New Jerusalem is the Triune God mingled together with the resurrected man, and the lake of fire is Satan’s ultimate destruction. The lake of fire is the place for Satan. All that is not related to the Triune God and the resurrected man will be put into the lake of fire with Satan. There will be only one tree in the New Jerusalem—the tree of life. The other tree will be in the lake of fire. This is the ultimate conclusion of the whole Scripture. The Scriptures began with three parties, but the ultimate consummation will be the New Jerusalem with only the first tree at the center of the city and the resurrected man as the expression of the Triune God. The second tree will be cast into the lake of fire. All things and all people related to the second tree will have the same destiny as Satan—in that lake of fire.

reference: Meghalaya State Planning Board Chairman calls on Chief Minister No.252/2021-2022 Aizawl the 18th August, 2021: Chief Minister Pu Zoramthanga, Chairman of State Planning Board was called on by State Planning Board Chairman Pu Lambor Malngiang (MLA/MDC), Meghalaya today at the formerâ€™s office where they discussed important issues relating to economic development for both states. The Meghalaya State Planning Board Chairman expressed his gratitude for the outstanding hospitality shown by Mizoram and hoped that the bond between the two states would continue to flourish. Speaking of how he works closely with Mizo community and many sub-tribes of Mizoram in his constituency, he expressed his optimism for an enduring friendship and partnership in all sectors. Mizoram Chief Minister echoed the importance of nurturing good relations between the two states, and said that should any situation arise where Mizoram can assist Meghalaya in the development of its economy, Mizoram shall do its best. After his meeting with the Chief Minister, Pu Lambor Malngiang met with Mizoram Planning Board Vice Chairman Pu H. Rammawi followed by a meeting with NGO leaders of the state. He was accompanied by Dr. Krishna Chauhan, Expert Member (Economist) Meghalaya State Planning Board and Pu Enrich GL Nongbri, Law Department, Govt. of Meghalaya. Attachment Loading attachment...

source: Governor Hari Babu leh ITCA hotupa in Mizorama zirlai thiam zual te tana space technology zir theih dan sawi dun 1070/2022-2023 Aizawl, the 28th June 2022: Vawiin chawhma khan Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati leh Dr SK Prasad, founder member and advisory council member, Indian Technology Congress Association ( ITCA), Bangalore te chu Raj Bhavan-ah an inkawm a. He hunah hian Mizorama zirlai thiam filawr te zinga space technology zir duh thlan chhuah dan tur leh an zir theih dan tur te an sawi dun a ni. Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati chuan Mizorama zirlaite chu lehkha thiam thei tak leh hmundanga zirlaite el phaka thluak tha an ni tih a sawi a. Space technology pawh a zirna kawng a inhawn phawt chuan hlawhtling takin an zir thei turah angai tih a sawi a ni. Governor chuan Dr SK Prasad leh a thawhna hmuna thuneituten Mizoramah zirlai te tan Space Technology zir theihna hun remchang an rawn zawn sak chu lawmawm a tih thu a sawi a. Hemi kawngah hian ITCA hotute chuan Higher & Technical Education Department, Mizoram University, NIT Mizoram, Polytechnics, Science & Technology Department leh Science Teachers Association Of Mizoram berawn se. Anni nena indawrna kaltlang hian zirlai thiam thei zual zinga space technology zir duhte thlanchhuah a awlsam a rin thu a sawi a ni. Dr SK Prasad chuan Prime Minister hmathlir angin India thalaite chu space technology lamah thiamna sang zawk nei tur leh India ram chu a hmahruaitu a nih theih nan chher hriam mek an ni a ti a. He hmalakna kal zelah hian zirlai team 75 te chu kumina project 75 thawk zo hman turin Students' Satellites 75 project hnuaiah satellite te chi(mini satellite) siam turin thlan an ni dawn an a ti. He project-ah hian India rama zirlaite zawng zawng an inel dawn a team 75 thlan an ni dawn a ti a. He project-ah hian Mizorama zirlaite tan pawh tel theihna hun a inhawng thei dawn niin a sawi a ni. Dr Prasad chuan a lo kal chhan tak chu Higher Secondary atanga University Degree zirlaite tan Space Technology zirna an kalpui mek chu Mizorama zirlaite rawn hmelhriat tir a ni a ti a. Hemi kawngah hian Governor leh state sawrkar hotute thlawpna a rawn ngen bakah a bikin science lam zirna kaihhnawiha hotute thawhpuiah a rawn sawm tih a sawi bawk a ni. reference: Governor Hari Babu and ITCA member discuss opportunities for students to learn space technology 102/2022-2023 Aizawl, the 28th June 2022: Dr SK Prasad, founder member and advisory council member, Indian Technology Congress Association ( ITCA) had called on Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati at the Raj Bhavan this forenoon. In this meeting, he and Governor discussed the opportunities for the students of higher secondary school, college and university in Mizoram to learn space technology. As proposed by his eminent guest, Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati welcomed the idea of selecting students with a scientific temper to have a preliminary introduction to space science with the option to continue the advanced study depending on their performance in studies. In this regard, he advised Dr SK Prasad and the institutions he represented to have close coordination with the authorities of Higher & Technical Education Department, Mizoram University, NIT Mizoram, Polytechnics, Science & Technology Department and Science Teachers Association Of Mizoram. Dr SK Prasad apprised the Governor of their initiatives in teaching the teams of students and assigning them important science projects like making mini satellites and other space technology. He explained the importance given to horning entrepreneurship skills of the students selected in this model of learning. He told Governor that his purpose of visiting is identifying the institutions with whom they will have a series of correspondences to initiate enrollment of the students in the program. source: CHAMPHAI DISTRICT TASK FORCE ON CORONA VIRUS OUTBREAK THUKHAWM Tunlaia China leh khawvel ram dangte ngaihven hlawh tak Novel Coronavirus (2019-nCoV) natna leng mek laka Champhai District lo him leh invenlawkna tura din, District Task Force on Corona Virus Outbreak chu a vawikhatna turin vawiin chawhnu khan Bawrhsap Pu SL Naveen, IAS hovin DC Conference Hall-ah an thukhawm. Meeting-ah hian Champhai District chu International Border-a awm anih avangin Novel Coronavirus leng darh zel tur laka fimkhur angaih thu tarlan niin, meeting chuan ramri kaltlanga veivak leh sumdawng thinte chu he natna len mekna hmun leh a chhehvelte laka fimkhur turin a ngen a. He hunah hian mihring veivak leh ran khuahkhirh anih dante ngaihthlak a ni bawk a. Champhai District ep Myanmar ram District-te nena inbiakpawh leh inzaitawn zela hmalak a tul thu pawh tarlan a ni a. District Task Force on Coronavirus Outbreak chuan ramri depa awm khuate chu tlawhchhuaka mipuite hnena zirtirna zau zawk kalpui nise, ramri kaltlanga lutte hriselna endik pahin chhui zui ngai awmte pawh chhuichian ni se a ti a. Champhai District Hospital-a Isolation Ward ruahman ni se tih bakah mamawh tur ang budget-te pawh a rang lama siama thuneitu sang zawk hnena thlen nise tih a ni. District Level Task Force on Corona Virus Outbreak hi Mizoram State Health Minister leh H&FW Department hotute January Ni 30, 2020 a thukhawm in an din tak State Level Task Force on Mitigation of Corona Virus duh dan anga district tina hma lo la tur a din a ni. reference: CHAMPHAI DISTRICT TASK FORCE ON CORONA VIRUS OUTBREAK HELD MEETING In pursuance of the decision made by Mizoram State Level Task Force on Mitigation of Corona Virus, Champhai District Task Force on Corona Virus was formed recently and held its first meeting at DC Conference Hall, yesterday. The meeting was presided over by Pu SL Naveen, IAS Deputy Commissioner Champhai. Given its strategic location, Champhai district being located nearby International Border, the meeting mentioned the needs for proper medical screening at Zokhawthar and restriction on movement particularly travellers based on their travelling history. To boost up the preventive measures, the meeting highlighted the importance of fostering better coordination with the neighbouring district administration of Myanmar. The meeting decided to organize awareness campaigns for villages nearby border areas and preparation of isolation ward for quarantine in case any suspect is detected. CMO Office was assigned to prepare budget encompassing all requirements for further submission to the higher authority. At the border Town of Zokhawthar, Government of Mizoram has been monitoring the situation and is conducting Medical Screening since the 4th of February 2020 with proper Self Reporting Form. source: MIZORAM POLICE PRESS STATEMENT 566/2023-2024 Mizoram police media cell chuan Digital Payment System chungchanga mipuite hnena thurawn a hnuaia mi ang hian a ti chhuak : DIGITAL PAYMENT INBUMNA CHUNGCHANGA THURAWN : Digital Payment Systems hman kan uar chhoh viau laiin hemi kaihhnawiha inbumna pawh nasa takin Mizoramah ngei pawh a sang chho chak hie a ni. Hetianga internet khawvela bum tur zawng ho hian rinhlelh nachang hre lo leh bum awlsam tur zawngin, inbum dan thar an hmu chhuak reng bawk. Tunah hian Mizorama Cyber Crime case ziah luh zinga 75% aia tarn hi 'online financial fraud' kaihhnawih a ni. Chuvangin hetianga inbumna laka kan himna atan Mizoram Poice chuan a hnuaia tarlan ang hian mipuite a ngen a ni: I banking password, OTP, Debit Card/Credit Card details te tumah hrilh suh. Pawisa dawngtu tur i nihin eng QR Code mah scan suh. Pawisa thawn chhuaktu tur tan lo chuan engmah scan a ngai lo. Phishing scammer te hian i Bank leh UPI information pawimawh ruksak che an turn reng tih hria la, email leh website lemah te, link hriat chian lohah te lut mai mai suh ang che. Online-a thil i lei dawnin Search Engine atanga product zawn hi a him tawk lo thin a, chuvangin online shopping website hriat chian saah ngei thil enin lei thin ang che. Engmah thawk mang lova pawisa hlawh theihna te, pawisa dah punna hlawk lutuk leh him si tih ang chi, thil tha uchuak lutuk ang hi inbumna a ni tlangpui tih hria ang che. Awlsam leh rang taka Loan pe chhuak thei anga insawi application leh website lakah fimkhur ang che. Loan pe turin mimal thil pawimawh tinreng an dil a, heng te hi a hnua blackmail lehna atan te an hmang thin a ni. Loan App i hmang a nih pawhin RBI phalna nei an ni ngei em tih chian ang che. Police/Army anga insawi a, thil tlawm tak taka tiral duh anga online-a inzuar thinte hi misual an ni tlangpui tih hre bawk ang che. Online a sum chet velna tur thil khawih reng rengin theihtawpa fimkhur turin mipuite kan chah nawn leh a, hetianga bumna tuartu i nih chuan Cyber Helpline 1930-ah emaw, www.cybercrime.gov.in ah emaw complaint i thehlut thei a ni. A HNUAIA TARLAN ANG HI www.cybercrime.gov.in AH COMPLAINT THEHLUH DAN A NI. 1. Mobile leh Computer browser (Google, Safari, etc.) eng atang pawhin www.cybercrime.gov.in i lut ang. 2. Box sen pahnih a lo awm ang a, "File Complaint' tih zawkah i lut ang. 3. "I Accept" tih a lo lang ang a, i lo click ang. 4. "Report Cyber Crime" tih i hmu ang a, i click ang. 5. Page thar a lo inhawng ang a, "Click here for new user" tihah lutin, form i fill-up ang. 6. Account i logged-in hnuah cyber crime category thlanna a lo awm ang a, i report duh category i thlang ang. 7. Online transaction hmanga bum i nih chuan "Online Financial Fraud" i thlang ang. 8. Pawisa thawn chhuaktu bank account details i chhu lut ang. 9. UPI hmanga pawisa thawn a nih chuan i UPI App hman (BHIM, Gpay, Paytm, etc.) i thlang ang. 10. I pawisa thawn chhuahna Transaction ID i chhu lut ang. Hriattur: Transaction ID hi digit 12 a ni a, pawisa i thawn a bank atanga SMS i dawn thin angah khan a awm. 11. I account-ah i hriatlohvin pawisa a lo lut a nih chuan "Credit Transaction Details" tihah khan a tul angin i fill up bawk dawn nia. 12. Hetianga a ml i tih zawh hnu hian "Save as Draft and Next" tih i thlang ang. 13. A phek dawt lehah a misual/bumtu i hriat chuan a details i fill up ang a, "Save as Draft and Next" i thlang leh ang. 14. A phek dawt lehah a tuartu/a complaint tu details i fill up ang a, "Save as Draft and Next" i thlang leh ang. 15. "I Agree" i thlang ang a, chumi hnuah "Confirm and Submit" i thlang leh dawn nia. Hetianga i tih zawh hnu hian SMS in acknowledgement number i dawng ang a, chumi hmang chuan i case chinchang i enzui duh hunah i enzui thei ang.
reference: MIZORAM POLICE PRESS STATEMENT 67/2023-2024 PUBLIC ADVISORY ON DIGITAL PAYMENT FRAUD With the increasing use of Digital Payment Systems, Mizoram has also witnessed a sharp increase in digital payment frauds. Cyber fraudsters are finding new methods to dupe vulnerable and unsuspecting citizens. Online financial frauds account for more than 75% of all cyber-crimes reported in the State. With an aim to prevent financial losses to the general public through online frauds, Mizoram Police once again appeals to public to take following precautions: 1. Never share your Banking password, OTP (one time password) or Debit/Credit Card details with others. 2. Never scan QR Code, when you are to receive money. It is only required for transferring money to other accounts. 3. Beware of phishing scams trying to steal your Banking or UPI information. Look out for fake emails and websites, that try to collect information and do not click on unknownâ€™unfamiliar links. 4. Always use familiar websites for online shopping rather than shopping by searching products on search engines. Search results can be misleading and may lead to malicious websites. 5. Ignore advertisements/deals, if they claim that you can earn money with little or no work or you can make money on an investment with little or no risk. If an offer seems too good to be true, it is most likely to be a scam. 6. Beware of fake loan apps that provide quick and easy loans. Such illegal apps will seek a variety of information and permissions from applicants, which is then misused to blackmail them later. If using digital loan app, please ensure that it has RBI authorization. 7. Beware of fraudsters, who impersonate as army/police personnel advertising cheap items online. We urge citizens to exercise extreme caution, while conducting financial transactions online. If you are a victim of financial fraud, call Cyber Helpline 1930 or register your complaints on www.cybercrime.gov.in . STEP BY STEP GUIDE ON REGISTRATION OF COMPLAINT AT www.cybercrime.gov.in : 1. Go to the website â€œ www.cybercrime.gov.inâ€ through any mobile or computer browser (Google, Safari, etc.) 2. There will be two red boxes. Select the box titled â€˜File a complaintâ€. 3. Click on the 7 Acceptâ€™ box that comes up. 4. Click on â€˜Report Cyber Crimeâ€™. 5. On the new page that comes up, first click on â€˜Click here for new userâ€™ on the top right and fill up the form. 6. After logging into your account, register your complaint. Select the cybercrime category that pertains to you. 7. If you were duped of money through an online transaction, select â€˜Online Financial Fraudâ€™ 8. Enter details of the bank account from which money was sent. 9. If payment was done through UPI, select the UPI app (BHIM, GPay, Paytm, etc) which you used to send money. 10. Enter the transaction ID of where you sent the money. Note: Transaction IDs are of 12 digits. They can be obtained from your bank statement or your UPI transaction details received through SMS. 11. If your account had been credited without your knowledge, enter the relevant details on â€˜Credit Transaction detailsâ€™. 12. After having entered all details as required, select â€˜Save as draft and Nextâ€™. 13. On the next page, enter details of the fraudster if you are aware. Then click on â€˜Save as draft and Nextâ€™. 14. On the next page, enter the complainant/victimâ€™s details and then click on â€˜Save as draft and Nextâ€™. 15. Lastly, click on â€˜I Agreeâ€™ and then â€˜Confirm and Submitâ€™. After this has been completed, you will receive an SMS with an acknowledgement number through which you will be able to keep track of your case.
